page.layout: Printed page turned sideways: running head at top, page number at top right. One full-width woodcut diagram (an oval figure with rotated labels and compass points Oriens, Meridies, Occidens, Septentrio at its edges) with the labels set around it. Below the figure at right, a catchword. No running text.
page.notes: The figure is a rotated woodcut; labels are read as they stand on the scan, and the numbers 1 to 9 set beside some labels are left out. Line order inside the figure follows the drawing and may not match reading order. The catchword "PARAL:" is uncertain at its final mark. The page number reads "475" and may be partly damaged.
